title: With no name typed, the blue line says "This term"
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Today's date on the calendar of {Location-A} is {Date-A}.
    For example: {Date-A} is Oct 21.
  • {Date-B} is {Date-A} plus 30 days.
    For example: {Date-B} is Nov 20 (Oct 21 + 30 days).
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group) is open on the Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Credit Term".
  2. Type 30 in the Days box.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the "New Credit Term" window opens.
  • Step 2: the blue line reads: "This term means payment is due 30 days after the invoice date. An invoice dated {Date-A} is due {Date-B}." and no Name error shows.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11672 (Story 3, Create or edit a credit term)

  • S3-R5, empty name and dates: “With the Name empty, "{Name}" reads "This term". Dates read as a short month and day ("Oct 21"). The line updates as the user types and disappears while the number is invalid.”
  • S3-R10: “The Name is checked only once the user has typed in it (then each time they leave the field) or presses Create / Save. Opening the window, or clicking an option or a box before typing a name, never shows a Name error.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf), read 23 Oct 2026: page "3 New credit term and Inactive tab" ("New credit term: Net X days"). Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the PRD quotes.

  • “The sentence under the fields updates as the shop types, so it sees what the term does before saving.”
